title: Tailwise Training Course Catalog: Price, Sessions and Class Format
content:
# Tailwise Training Course Catalog

Tailwise Training sells six courses and packs. Each is priced as one course or pack, credits a fixed number of sessions when the dog is enrolled, and is delivered either in a group class or as one-to-one private sessions.

## Catalog figures by course

| Course or pack | Price (USD) | Sessions credited at enrollment | Session length | Format | Most dogs in one class | Family members who may attend with the dog |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Training 6-Week Group | 149.00 | 6 | 60 minutes | Group | 8 | 2 |
| Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group | 149.00 | 6 | 60 minutes | Group | 8 | 2 |
| Intermediate Training 6-Week Group | 159.00 | 6 | 60 minutes | Group | 8 | 2 |
| Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group | 179.00 | 6 | 60 minutes | Group | 6 | 2 |
| Private Training 4-Session Pack | 279.00 | 4 | 60 minutes | Private | 1 | 4 |
| Private Training 8-Session Pack | 499.00 | 8 | 60 minutes | Private | 1 | 4 |

## Reading the catalog

- **Price** is the course or pack price in US dollars, before any household or membership discount.
- **Sessions credited at enrollment** is the number of training sessions placed on the enrollment when the dog is enrolled. Sessions belong to that one enrollment and that one dog.
- **Format** is either group (a class of several dogs) or private (one dog with the trainer). The four 6-Week Group courses are group courses; the two Private Training packs are private.
- **Most dogs in one class** is the class size ceiling. For the private packs the figure is 1, because a private session holds only the enrolled dog.
- **Family members who may attend with the dog** is the number of handlers from the household who may come to a session with the dog: up to 2 on every group course and up to 4 on either private pack.

## Points of comparison

- The Puppy Training 6-Week Group and the Adult Basic Training 6-Week Group carry the same price, session count and class size; they differ in the dogs they admit, not in these catalog figures.
- Every course and pack in the Tailwise Training catalog runs 60-minute sessions.
- Of the group courses, only the Advanced Training & CGC Prep 6-Week Group caps its class at 6 dogs rather than 8.
- The Private Training 8-Session Pack credits twice the sessions of the Private Training 4-Session Pack at a price of 499.00 against 279.00.
